name: helix
runtime: window.helix on the studio page. Same-origin frames may post { type: 'helix.run', id, commands } and listen for { type: 'helix.result', id, result }.
units: Metres. Y is up. Yaw is degrees. Heading 0 faces world -Z. W drives, A turns left, D turns right.
build: await helix.build([{ op: 'room', id: 'hall', x: -4, z: -3, width: 8, depth: 6, door: 'south' }]). Ops: site, room, wall, door, window, roof, furnish. A failed step rolls the batch back. helix.world(), helix.validate(), helix.query({ x, z, radius, kind }), helix.benchmark(). Construction does not render until the batch commits.

commands.does: Remove props. Keeps the stage and the warden.
asset is a catalog id, an exact title, or a unique fragment such as knight.
role is gate, loot, currency, skin, or vendor. token is a symbol such as KEY, or pass a 0x contract. skin binds to target or the warden.
Puts a sample token in the studio wallet so a rule can be tested. Does not send a transaction.
